phaseBaseline.note: Recorded at the start of Phase 6C (2026-10-17 19:38 IST). The preferences hash differed from the Phase 6B gate result (78d11267…) because the preview app was used on the device at 19:22 IST (usagestats: usedByUser; file modified 19:22:18). No tooling touched the preview app.

what_happened: Before a targeted instrumented run, the first protected-hash read (adb shell run-as … sha256sum) timed out. qemu-system-x86_64 (PID 26940) used 0 CPU seconds over 5 s and was reported as not responding; no test had started. Host free memory was 2,158 MB.
steps: Stopped the Gradle daemon and one Kotlin build process that were waiting on the device.
Stopped the hung emulator and started the same AVD with its original flags: -no-snapshot-load -no-snapshot-save (cold boot from the current disk; no snapshot rollback).
No app data was cleared, uninstalled, reseeded or migrated; nothing was installed into in.jansetu.app.
result: All four protected preview hashes are identical to the Phase 6C baseline. This is the second emulator hang in two days (see phase6b-emulator-restart.json); the emulator should be checked for host stability before long device runs.
